name: skin
description: /skin <name> recolours the whole Claude desktop app with one of 16 skins (each with a light and a dark half). The first skin needs one tick of Developer > Enable Main Process Debugger; later switches need none until Claude quits. /skin off, /skin remove, /skin status, /skin check (is the skin still working), /skin type on|off (optional project headers coloured by activity), /skin font <name>|off|list (optional body fonts, in copies that have them). One line can set several parts: /skin dracula font plex type on. /skin fonts opens a card above the message box to choose the font, size and weight of each part (chat text, sidebar rows, project headers, everything else). /skin log shows the troubleshooting log.

toolDir.title: Reskin tool folder
toolDir.description: The folder that holds skin-auto.mjs. Leave empty when the tool sits beside this mod (skin-tool).

node.title: Node path
node.description: Node 22 or newer. Leave empty to look in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, then PATH.
